title: ZnS QDs and Nanomaterials Research
summary: This cluster revolves around the research on ZnS quantum dots (QDs) and their interactions with various organisms and chemicals. ZnS QDs are manufactured by IMEM-CNR and have been characterized using dynamic light scattering. They are exposed to yeast strains and wild-type organisms, causing cell death and modulating the mitochondrion. Additionally, ZnS QDs have been found to induce hypersensitivity in pos5Δ and are treated with BY4742. Nanomaterials research has been published by several authors, including Guisbiers Gregory, Luche Sophia, Marmiroli Marta, Marmiroli Nelson, and Pagano Luca. CdS QDs have been exposed to YKO collections and have higher tolerance in glr1Δ.
